description: A script for deobfuscating minified JavaScript stack traces using source maps, including argument parsing, source map fetching and caching, stack trace parsing, and source context display.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into options for the script.

methods.name: findInRepo
methods.description: Searches the repository for a file matching a suffix, trying progressively shorter suffixes.

methods.name: resolveSourcePathAsync
methods.description: Resolves a source file path, attempting local, cached, or remote sources, with fuzzy fallback.

methods.name: findRepoRoot
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the git repository by looking for a .git folder.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and options for the script.

methods.name: parseStackTrace
methods.description: Parses raw stack trace text into structured frame objects.

methods.name: fetchRemote
methods.description: Fetches remote source map files over HTTP/HTTPS.

methods.name: loadSourceMap
methods.description: Loads a source map from local cache, local directory, or remote URL.

methods.name: tryDemangleDotted
methods.description: Attempts to resolve dotted minified symbols to original names using source maps.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves source code lines around a specific line and column for context display.
